basic_details.job_title: DC Dhubri Revenue Sheristadar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The post of Revenue Sheristadar under the amalgamated establishment of the District Commissioner, Dhubri is open to candidates who have served at least 15 years in any District Commissioner's Establishment in Assam. Applications in the Standard Form go through the proper channel to the District Commissioner, Dhubri, and must reach the office on or before 21 December 2026. The advertisement is issued by the Office of the District Commissioner, Dhubri District, Dhubri (Personnel Branch), Government of Assam.

qualification.details: Service requirement: The candidate must have served at least 15 (fifteen) years in any of the District Commissioner's Establishment in Assam. Experience: The candidate must have experiences in different branches in general and the Revenue branch in particular. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, although the application must state the candidate's educational qualification. Age limit: Not specified in the notice; the application must state the candidate's age. Pay: Pay Band Rs. 22000-97000 + Grade Pay Rs. 11,500/- per month plus other allowances as admissible as per the provisions of the Assam Services (R.O.P) Rules, 2017. Service rules: The post is under the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967, as amended. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit, the application fee or the minimum educational qualification.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the Standard Form as published in the Assam Gazette in Part-IX. It is to be submitted through the proper channel, with service particulars, to the District Commissioner, Dhubri. The notice states that applications should reach the undersigned on or before 21 December 2026. The application must state the following: Age Educational qualification Present and permanent address Experience in different branches The District Commissioners and Co-District Commissioners of Assam have been requested to forward the applications of intending candidates working under their establishment, along with A.C.R.s of the last five years, so that they reach the District Commissioner, Dhubri on or before the specified date. The notice does not mention a postal mode, an email address or a superscription for the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Service requirement: The candidate must have served at least 15 (fifteen) years in any of the District Commissioner's Establishment in Assam. Experience: The candidate must have experiences in different branches in general and the Revenue branch in particular. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, although the application must state the candidate's educational qualification. Age limit: Not specified in the notice; the application must state the candidate's age. Pay: Pay Band Rs. 22000-97000 + Grade Pay Rs. 11,500/- per month plus other allowances as admissible as per the provisions of the Assam Services (R.O.P) Rules, 2017. Service rules: The post is under the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967, as amended. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates A copy of recent passport size photograph Annual Confidential Reports (ACRs) of the last 5 (five) consecutive years 'No DP or CP pending certificate' Service particulars

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be done by the Government in the General Administration Department as per the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967 and the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service (Amendment) Rules, 1999. Candidates shall have to appear for the interview as and when called for, at their own expense if necessary. No TA/DA shall be admissible for the journey. The notice does not give an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the DC Dhubri Revenue Sheristadar application?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the District Commissioner, Dhubri on or before 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the Revenue Sheristadar post in Dhubri?
faq.answer: Candidates who have served at least 15 (fifteen) years in any District Commissioner's Establishment in Assam, with experience in different branches in general and the Revenue branch in particular, can apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of a Revenue Sheristadar at DC Dhubri?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Band Rs. 22000-97000 + Grade Pay Rs. 11,500/- per month, as per the Assam Services (R.O.P) Rules, 2017.

faq.question: Q4. Are allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says the pay is plus other allowances as admissible as per the provisions of the Assam Services (R.O.P) Rules, 2017.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the DC Dhubri Revenue Sheristadar post?
faq.answer: Apply in the Standard Form published in the Assam Gazette in Part-IX and submit it through the proper channel, with service particulars, to the District Commissioner, Dhubri.

faq.question: Q6. What documents must be attached to the application?
faq.answer: Attach self-attested copies of certificates, a recent passport size photograph, Annual Confidential Reports of the last 5 consecutive years and a 'No DP or CP pending certificate'.

faq.question: Q7. How will the Revenue Sheristadar be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be done by the Government in the General Administration Department as per the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967 and the (Amendment) Rules, 1999, and candidates shall appear for the interview as and when called for.

faq.question: Q8. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. Candidates appear for the interview at their own expense, and no TA/DA shall be admissible for the journey.
